chapter: From Pittsburgh to Maxine Sullivan: management and style
title: Younger jazz singers, fusion singers and changing times
summary: They discuss Shirley Horn, Betty Carter, Irene Kral and fusion singers like Urszula Dudziak; she says each has their own era.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
